# `<=`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
expr1 <= expr2
```

Returns true if `expr1` is less than or equal to `expr2`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented (SQL syntax) |
| Group | `predicate_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- <=, example 1
> SELECT 2 <= 2;
true
```

```sql
-- <=, example 2
> SELECT 1.0 <= '1';
true
```

```sql
-- <=, example 3
> SELECT to_date('2009-07-30 04:17:52') <= to_date('2009-07-30 04:17:52');
true
```

```sql
-- <=, example 4
> SELECT to_date('2009-07-30 04:17:52') <= to_date('2009-08-01 04:17:52');
true
```

```sql
-- <=, example 5
> SELECT 1 <= NULL;
NULL
```
